reason: Freeze every remaining deterministic implementation choice needed by the once-only outcome runner before y.wide.dryad.csv is downloaded or parsed.

runtime.policy: the synthetic-smoke and once-only outcome workflows use the same pinned numerical runtime

early_detection_boundary.use: remove a site from the 2007 first-detection risk set when an archived positive already occurred
early_detection_boundary.layer_a_update: do not eliminate frozen worlds from pre-2007 detections because the frozen response/update period begins in 2007

supervised_preprocessing.logistic_models: fit a separate calibration-only mean/SD transform for each frozen feature set; drop columns with calibration SD <= 1e-12; use L2 lbfgs C=1 and max_iter=3000
supervised_preprocessing.random_forest: use finite raw frozen features without standardization

hmm_covariate_scaling.hydroperiod: Intermittent is the reference; Semi-permanent and Permanent indicators remain unscaled
hmm_covariate_scaling.year_horizon: standardize the 2008-2012 transition horizons using calibration values only
hmm_covariate_scaling.wind_temperature: replace missing visit covariates by the response-free 2007-2012 global median, then standardize using all resulting calibration visit values
hmm_covariate_scaling.heldout: apply the frozen calibration transforms without refitting

hmm_likelihood.initial_state: Bernoulli occupancy with the frozen initial-occupancy logit
hmm_likelihood.destroyed_site_years: force prior and posterior occupancy to zero from 2010 onward
hmm_likelihood.emission: conditional-independent Bernoulli detections over finite visits; missing visits contribute one
hmm_likelihood.optimization: bounded L-BFGS-B over 15 coefficients from zero plus four fixed-seed N(0,0.5) starts; select the converged finite minimum calibration NLL
hmm_likelihood.prediction: before each heldout response, prior occupancy times one-minus-the-product of visit non-detection probabilities over archived surveyed visits
hmm_likelihood.filtering: after each heldout response, update posterior occupancy for the next heldout year

layer_a_denominator.members: only rules surviving before the current year's response
layer_a_denominator.surviving_world_fraction: surviving member count divided by the original declared count of five

decision_completion.layer_b_adverse_if: macro-year logloss(EOG - mean-only) > 0 and EOG wins in at most one of five heldout years
decision_completion.layer_b_no_confirmed_if: neither the frozen favorable rule nor the adverse rule is met
decision_completion.external_adverse_if: EOG macro-year log loss exceeds the best external comparator and EOG beats the best available external comparator in at most one heldout year
decision_completion.external_no_confirmed_if: neither the frozen favorable rule nor the adverse rule is met
decision_completion.universe_falsification: if all worlds are eliminated before all five heldout years are scored, the primary endpoint is non-estimable; elimination after the final heldout score is preserved separately from the completed metrics

workflow_order: commit the frozen runner and this amendment
run the full runner on deterministic synthetic detections while y.wide.dryad.csv is absent
require HMM convergence, finite predictions, five heldout metric years and an allowed decision state
freeze the smoke result and keep the runner unchanged
only then download the exact checksummed y.wide.dryad.csv once and run the empirical outcome
